features.name: Mobile task inbox
features.state: PARTIAL (responsive web inbox, real Chromium at 375px against the real section2 service; no native mobile app, no real phone)
features.detail: Queued intakes with approve/reject, 44px touch targets, no horizontal overflow, hostile titles inert, non-http links dropped, approval states plainly that no run starts. Server denies a viewer's decision (403). Role gating of the buttons is the shell's canDecide input, not derived here.

features.name: Bitbucket and Azure DevOps adapters
features.state: PARTIAL (intake only, fake payloads; live delivery NEEDS EXTERNAL VALIDATION)
features.detail: Bitbucket Cloud: HMAC-SHA256 X-Hub-Signature, per-X-Request-UUID idempotency, bot/team actors ignored, project mismatch refused, comment write-back via guarded client (merge/approve/decline blocked). Azure DevOps: shared-secret header or Basic auth only (not body-bound, weaker than HMAC; TLS-only by policy), delivery id from the authenticated body, project-scoped match, no write-back (NEEDS INTEGRATION). Payload shapes are written from provider docs, not captured from live hooks.

features.name: Guided onboarding
features.detail: GET /onboarding derives five steps from what the user actually did (tutorial created, session opened, readiness run, change applied, verification recorded); progress is per user and cannot be self-asserted. No UI wizard beyond the CLI/API output.

features.name: Repository readiness check
features.detail: Read-only check of tracked files (hardened git ls-files): README, tests, CI, lockfile, .gitignore, CODEOWNERS, credential-looking text. Secrets block the verdict and are reported by path only, never echoed. Heuristics are shallow; a pass is not a security audit.

features.name: Tutorial project
features.detail: Idempotent per team+user service-owned repo with a seeded failing test (verified failing); openable as a code session because only the tutorial root is added to allowed repo roots. Python-only lesson.

features.name: Task templates
features.detail: Five templates; parameters are required, length-limited, control-char stripped, unknown keys refused; rendering returns a goal and never starts a run. Template quality with real agents is unevaluated.

risks.note: Templates + tutorial + inbox shorten first use; no usability study.
packages/dev-cli: token from env only, redacted errors, https/localhost base, tested against the real service. Not published/installed anywhere.
Carried from S3; host validation still blocked.
Human approval stays the only path from intake to work; no live provider journey.
Readiness never echoes secrets; CLI keeps token out of argv/output.
Azure's non-body-bound secret is a recorded weaker control; flooding limited by per-registration rate limit.
Bitbucket client blocks merge/approve/decline; no merge path added.
